script.title: How Indian Space Startups Make Money #shorts

segments.text: Space startups in India are no longer just rocket science experiments.
Indian satellite startup SatSure just raised sixty crore rupees from a government space fund.
segments.broll: hands counting rupee notes close up

segments.text: But how do space startups actually make paisa? They don't build rockets.
segments.broll: young engineer working on laptop close up

segments.text: Instead, they sell high-tech satellite data to Indian banks and crop insurance firms.
segments.broll: indian farmer in green field wide
broll_alt: hands using tablet outdoors close up

segments.text: By scanning farms from space, banks can verify crop health before issuing loans.
segments.broll: aerial view of green agricultural field
broll_alt: digital scan overlay on green landscape

segments.text: This cuts manual verification costs for banks while giving startups massive recurring revenue.
segments.broll: banker typing on computer close up

segments.text: That's why deep-tech is turning into serious business in India. Not financial advice.
segments.broll: bengaluru city modern skyline sunset aerial

script.description: Indian space tech startups are transforming from research projects into profitable B2B businesses. Here is how satellite data companies like SatSure make money by selling crop intelligence to banks and insurers. #SpaceTech #IndianStartups #PaisaDecoded
